title: TimeValues
description: Time value formats shared by every schema. Instants never carry fractional seconds.

instant.title: Instant
instant.description: RFC 3339 instant with an explicit offset and whole seconds (inputs may use any offset).

utcInstant.title: UtcInstant
utcInstant.description: RFC 3339 instant in UTC (`Z`) with whole seconds. Every computed instant is written this way.

localDate.title: LocalDate
localDate.description: Calendar date in the user's time zone.

timeZone.title: TimeZone
timeZone.description: IANA time zone name, for example `Australia/Sydney` or `UTC`. `x-timeZone`: validators also reject a name the platform's time zone database cannot resolve (SEMANTICS.md §1).
